cells: Companion implementation workbook. Exact six-stat values and abilities remain authoritative in Regional_Dex_Stats_and_Abilities_COMPLETE_v2.xlsx; this adds evolution timing/methods, deterministic promotion rules, species learnsets, food capture values and Hell terrain rules.
100 XP always produces one level; excess XP carries over. XP is level-gap based and calculated independently for each participant.
Each level performs six independent RNG growth rolls weighted from the species' canonical six base stats.
Evolution is deterministic: add target base stat minus source base stat to each live stat. Do not reroll growths.
Most evolutions are level-based. Branches use elemental/material items unless the design is explicitly about allegiance, oath or side-taking.
Each species has its own level-up learnset; only four moves can be active. Earlier legal moves remain relearnable.
Capture uses the exact Generation III Pokémon calculation; food replaces the Poké Ball bonus.
Hell Wardens use normal battle rules. Each starts with one persistent visible weather/terrain-style field their team exploits.
No trade evolutions. Route encounters remain authored tables with fixed level ranges and no scaling.
Regional_Dex_Stats_and_Abilities_COMPLETE_v2.xlsx — canonical types, exact HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe, BSTs and abilities.
Pokemon_Fan_Game_354_Move_Catalogue.xlsx — legal move names, PP, power and effects; this workbook assigns them into species learnsets.
Pokemon_Story_Bible_Full_Plot_LOCKED_v1.0.docx — Nine Circles and Warden identities; older bespoke Warden interface rules are superseded by terrain-only battles.
Capture reference: https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Catch_rate plus the Generation III Net/Repeat/Timer/Nest Ball pages.
One row per species. Evolution timing is chosen from canonical BST jump, line length and rarity/pacing; promotion deltas are read from the canonical base-stat rows.
